title: Period and Graph of y = cos(pi*x)
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine the fundamental period of the function y = \cos(\pi x) and identify the key coordinates of its graph over one full period.

steps.title: Compute the Fundamental Period
steps.explanation: Matching y = cos(pi*x) with frequency omega = pi gives the period B = 2*pi / pi = 2.
steps.why: As x increases by 2, the argument pi*x increases by 2*pi, completing one full cosine cycle.

steps.title: Determine Amplitude and Symmetry
steps.explanation: The curve has amplitude 1, range [-1, 1], and is symmetric about the y-axis because cosine is an even function.
steps.why: Replacing x with -x leaves cos(pi*x) unchanged.

steps.title: Locate Key Quarter-Period Points on [0, 2]
steps.explanation: With quarter-period 2/4 = 1/2, the graph starts at its maximum (0, 1), crosses the x-axis at 1/2, reaches its minimum at (1, -1), crosses at 3/2, and returns to (2, 1).
steps.why: Evaluating cos(pi*x) at x = 0, 1/2, 1, 3/2, 2 gives cos(0), cos(pi/2), cos(pi), cos(3*pi/2), cos(2*pi).
